title: Apply for a charitable fundraising authority
summary: Learn about and apply for a charitable fundraising authority if you raise money for a charitable purpose in NSW.
intro:
If you raise more than $15,000 in a financial year for a charitable purpose in NSW, you must have an authority to fundraise from NSW Fair Trading.

However, from 1 April 2026, ACNC registered charities do not need to apply for or hold a NSW charitable fundraising authority, as they are automatically taken to hold a deemed authority. ACNC registered charities no longer need to apply for or renew a NSW authority.

For non ACNC registered charities, an authority continues to operate under NSW law and must be renewed as required.

An authority lasts for up to 5 years and there is no limit to the number of fundraising appeals covered by a valid authority. You can apply to renew your authority for 1, 3 or 5 years before it expires or up to 3 months after the expiry date.

The authority holder must provide written authority to people who volunteer or receive a wage, commission or fee to fundraise on their behalf towards the charitable purpose.

The Charitable Fundraising Guidelines provide information on:
who_can_apply: Must raise more than $15,000 in a financial year for a charitable purpose in NSW.
Non-ACNC registered charities must apply for and hold an authority, as ACNC registered charities are automatically deemed to hold one from 1 April 2026.
what_you_need: Copy of the terms of an appeal (if you are an individual).
Copy of the latest audited financial statements (if applicable).
Statement of objects setting out the purpose and range of activities.
Constitution or trust deed and/or certificate of registration or corporation (for non-ACNC registered charities).
No fee is required to apply for the authority.

how_to_steps.text: You'll have the option to log in using your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to complete your application.
Download Charitable fundraising authority – application – PDF.
Email your application to the address on the form.

contact: If you have any questions about a charitable fundraising authority email NSW Fair Trading or call 13 32 20.

faqs.q: Do I need a charitable fundraising authority?
faqs.a: You must have an authority if you raise more than $15,000 in a financial year for a charitable purpose in NSW.

faqs.q: Do ACNC registered charities still need to apply for an authority?
faqs.a: No, from 1 April 2026, ACNC registered charities do not need to apply for or hold a NSW charitable fundraising authority, as they are automatically taken to hold a deemed authority.

faqs.q: How long does an authority last and how do I renew it?
faqs.a: An authority lasts for up to 5 years. You can renew it for 1, 3, or 5 years before it expires or up to 3 months after the expiry date.
